event.description: Remove BOS and shift retained absolute positions left
event.proposal: Family: token representation. Current retained frontier is 3,376 parameters at 99.180000%, a +0.180000 percentage-point margin over 99%. There have been 5 prior attempts in this family. The most recent accepted result is attempt-0016, fixed-length EOS/position removal at 3,376 parameters and 99.18% official accuracy; the most recent failed result is attempt-0014, a fresh-optimization failure for PAD-free semantics with no official score. Hypothesis: BOS may be unnecessary because the delimiter and absolute positions already anchor the fixed stream; dropping its tied vocabulary row and shifting each retained real-token positional vector left saves 32 parameters, yielding 3,344. This is a representational change because the constant BOS key/value disappears from attention, unlike attempts-0015/0016. It is more informative than the nearest untested fresh BOS-free training alternative because checkpoint surgery preserves all real-token embeddings and weights, isolating BOS attention participation from optimization instability.
